_why: Voice registers on the free local route (Chatterbox, MIT weights, voice/LICENSING.md). Owner decision 2026-10-13 (docs/CHANNEL-PLAN.md, A third domain: food science): the food videos open hooked, then the pace slows and the voice lowers so the video works as wind-down. 'calm' switches in at the title card. Guarded by validator V54 (loop/validate.py) and loop/tests/test_food_voice_sound.py, which measure the rendered audio, not this file.

calm.note: slower, lower, more pause: one sentence per breath (max_words 18) with a 0.75 s rest between sentences and 1.5 s between paragraphs; Chatterbox's lower cfg_weight paces more deliberately and lower exaggeration flattens the delivery; the pitch shift resamples, which lowers pitch AND slows the read by the same factor (2^(-2/12) = 0.891). Measured on the first sample: -1.5 semitones and 40-word chunks left calm only 1.3x standard's pauses - too close to tell apart.

contract._pace: pace = words / total beat seconds, pauses included: what a listener hears as slow
